name: 07504 · Paterson, NJ
findings: ZIP 07504 (Paterson) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07504 (Paterson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07504 (Paterson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
